subject: One-Day Liquor Licenses for September Events
overview: The commission approved one-day liquor licenses for three community events in September and discussed the regulatory status of specialty cooking wine.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the July 13 meeting.

items.title: Medford Family Network Gala One-Day License
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for a gala at Wright's Pond on September 10, with the condition that the event utilize a TIPS-certified bartender.

items.title: Music Festival One-Day License
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for a music festival at the Condon Shell on September 18, with the applicant agreeing to implement perimeter signage defining the alcohol service area.

items.title: Run MedFed Road Race One-Day License
items.summary: Approved a one-day license for a road race on September 18, conditioned on the applicant providing a site diagram for the beer garden once the location is finalized.

items.title: Sale of Mirin Cooking Wine at Ebisuya Market
items.summary: Discussed a request from Ebisuya Market to sell Mirin and requested further legal research into alcohol content thresholds and neighboring municipalities' policies.
